sampling.precision: float32 on the CPU (the release runs float16 on CUDA; its noise is drawn on CUDA)

capture.notes: The sampling loop is generate.py's own source, run with exec on the CPU in float32; hooks only observe. pytorch/diffusion_oasis.py's whole model is run on the inputs of every call at the three detail steps of every frame and must reproduce the DiT's output (checkedModelVsDit). Block 1 is re-run with the checked blocks from its captured input; attention weights come from its q and k and must reproduce its SDPA output. rolloutDrift: the checked blocks' own free-running rollout from the same noise, which drifts as per-call float differences compound.
